Gojo · Utility ecology

A small market for useful distinctions

Empty local models learn from physical consequences, publish condensed direction advice, and spend finite resources on further work. This review shows what helped, what remained costly, and how the controls differ.

8 fresh seeds · 10 arms · 163,840 complete world steps · 5.7 minutes · no paid Jev calls

Full report · Mechanism and run instructions

A bounded mechanism trial. Costs are abstract resource units. The supplied buyer, service grammar and prices are experimental contracts; the study does not establish an optimal market or open-ended invention.

From open interpretation to a useful distinction

1 · Open

No supported answer

Samples expose physical presence with open magnitude. Initially no direction is supported; fallback actions can still generate learning evidence.

2 · Presence

One response may suffice

A source can learn a useful direction without comparing magnitudes. Stable common demand initially permits this simple publication.

3 · Ordinal

Pay for needed differences

Pressure can sponsor a bounded model of opaque anchors and order. Refinement can remain open or fail; a larger model does not guarantee utility.

Four service scaffolds, orientation and binary opposed actions are supplied. A native product of issued direction and actual consequence sign derives the successful direction. The world never supplies that label through a learner port.

Ten comparative arms

Each mean uses seeds as replicates and includes holds, failed work and all world steps. Seed ranges describe variability; statistical intervals and interpretation belong in the report.

Producer advice can remain available in the communication-withdrawn arm. It does not mean that the consumer received it. Phase/source burn assigns globally scheduled maintenance and initial construction to the current request, so this allocation is not a component's causal marginal cost.

Occasional utility and retained knowledge

A useful rare service is quiet for two whole phases, then returns with the same physical law. The use-reset arm pays to discard and rebuild after inactivity; the retained arm can reuse its interpretation. Parked storage has zero rent in this trial.

New utility remains costly in the full arm

Full-arm new-source net: -0.22 per request; 2 of 8 full-arm seeds were profitable. The full arm has negative mean return on the newly useful source. Periodic opportunity tests did not make this source profitable within the supplied budget.

Source 3 begins as unpredictable traffic and becomes ordinally useful only in phase 3. Funding, inherited evidence and buyer rejection can still prevent useful re-entry. No hidden change announcement or direct success label repairs those failures.

One actual run, step by step

This is the full success-paid arm, seed 600. Scenario phase and source descriptions are visible to this reviewer; they are not learner inputs. The stories below locate early interpretation and later paid changes without replacing the complete recorded trace.

Advice is captured before the current update; landmark count is captured after any refinement or reset. The stage description is approximate on edited steps. Stable common-source phase 0 provides the presence example; stable phase 2 provides the ordinal example.

  • The no-learning arm starts with empty models, while its alternating fallback can physically act.
  • Success-paid fees are conserved internal transfers. Successful fallback can pay a supplier with an open publication, so this is attributed task success, not causal contribution credit.
  • Opportunity traffic means a purchased request; funded demand means sufficient buyer reserve. The gate is authored and does not learn the value of a computation.
  • High error can keep requesting work on noise. Reserve exhaustion bounds spending but does not establish recognition of irreducible noise.

Prices and evidence boundaries

Fee 2 transfers internally. Purchased execution 1, comparison 1, gate inspection 1, a granted learning attempt 1, construction 8 and an ordinal proposal/reset 16 enter retained burn sinks. Active rent is 1 per 32 world tasks; parked rent is zero. Abstract work excludes some reads, sampling, output and actual CPU time.

Currency is checked on every step: buyer, suppliers, attention, escrow and work sinks equal initial funding plus signed external physical outcomes. Group return subtracts burned work once; internal fees redistribute existing resources.

10 saved first-seed graphs; all declared checks passed. Saved replay covers retained ordinal anchor classes or fresh presence-only requests and paid gate continuation through a declared reconnected ordered fixture. It does not reconnect an arbitrary novel physical sample to the world's private metric dictionary.

Provider duplicate-feedback exclusion is not guaranteed. This synchronous trial admits each receipt once. A bounded supplied grammar, four initial scaffolds and authored action law remain necessary context for every result.
